messages.snippet: Dear All, The firm's document management system (FileShare) will be unavailable this Saturday 24 Jan
messages.subject: Planned maintenance — document management system, Sat 24 Jan
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear All,

The firm's document management system (FileShare) will be unavailable this Saturday 24 January between 07:00 and 13:00 for scheduled maintenance and a security patch. Please check in any documents you are working on before Friday evening. Email and calendar are unaffected.

Thank you,
IT Helpdesk
